bibl.title: Where Dreams May Come. Incubation Sanctuaries in the Greco-Roman World
bibl.seg: Gil H. Renberg, Where Dreams May Come. Incubation Sanctuaries in the Greco-Roman World = Religions in the Greco-Roman World. 184/I; -184/II.
Leiden - Boston, Brill, 2017, lxx & xiv-1046 pp. en 2 voll., figg. ISBN 978-90-04-29976-4. €243.
C.R. par Luigi Prada, BibO 76 (2019) coll. 116-122. - Megan Nutzman, BMCRev < https://bmcr.brynmawr.edu/2019/2019.01.41 >.
